item.description: We embed accessibility into our design process to create better experiences for everyone. Explore accessible technology, training, and inclusive innovation.

item.title: Accessibility - Wikipedia
item.description: Accessibility can be viewed as the "ability to access" and benefit from some system or entity.

item.title: ACCESSIBILITY Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: The meaning of ACCESSIBILITY is the quality or state of being accessible.

item.title: Computer accessibility - Wikipedia
item.description: Computer accessibility refers to the accessibility of a computer system to all people, regardless of disability type, English literacy or digital fluency.

item.title: Accessibility Trends to Watch in 2026 - Accessibility.com
item.description: Digital accessibility is moving from “fix it at the end” to “build it in from the start.” In 2026, the most significant shifts are about how teams design, build, test, and govern accessible experiences across websites, apps, documents, and emerging interfaces.

item.title: Intro to Accessibility: The What, Why, and How of Accessibility - eSAIL
item.description: In this tutorial, we'll discuss the what, why, and how of accessibility: what it is, why it's important, and how we do it.

item.title: ACCESSIBILITY | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary
item.description: The accessibility of her plays means that she is able to reach a wide audience. The quality and accessibility of materials have to be high if there are to be no barriers to learning.
